title: India News Today – Friday, October 30, 2026
description: A helicopter crashed in Uttarakhand on Friday afternoon, killing all six people on board, including the pilot. The Trans Bharat Aviation helicopter was flying from Badrinath to Dehradun when it went down near Joshimath in Chamoli district amid rain and heavy cloud. Officials say it lost contact shortly after takeoff.

description: Former Deputy Prime Minister L.K. Advani is in intensive care at Apollo Hospital in Delhi with a chest infection. The ninety-eight-year-old B.J.P. veteran was admitted on Friday evening.
